Three [[Prismatic Ooze]]s are the final end bosses of the [[Ooze Pit]]. They are powerful foes and cast a combination of 4 strong elemental spells. The skills [[Pain Inverter]] and [[Ward Against Elements]] are strongly recommended.

*[[Blob of Ooze]]

== Notes ==
* Prismatic Oozes cannot be [[interrupt]]ed in [[hard mode]], even when [[dazed]].
* Their combined [[area of effect]] spells can [[wipe]] out even a very well-prepared [[party]]. Rather than fighting them toe-to-toe, consider sending only a few party members in to deal damage, being able to [[tank]] while the party heals them from out of the Prismatic Oozes' range.
* Two [[Hulking Volatile Ooze]]s spawn when a Primatic Ooze dies.
* The [[Prismatic Chest]] appears after defeating the third (and final) Prismatic Ooze.
